ideahub.description: Your Ideas. Your History. Your Proof.
ideahub.configuration.title: IdeaHub
ideahub.configuration.proofAutoCommit.de: Automatically commit the marker line to local git after inserting a proof or publish marker (never pushes).
ideahub.configuration.proofCommitMessage: Commit message template for proof markers. Supports the {project} and {time} placeholders; unknown placeholders are kept verbatim and an empty value falls back to the default.
ideahub.configuration.publishCommitMessa: Commit message template for publish markers. Supports the {project} and {time} placeholders; unknown placeholders are kept verbatim and an empty value falls back to the default.
